dimensions.assessment: Applies nationally to individuals involved in the production or importation of certain visual depictions, as well as federal prosecutors and law enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: This bill broadens the scope of prohibited conduct under two federal criminal statutes related to the production of child pornography.

dimensions.assessment: Expands criminal liability and potential penalties for covered offenses under federal law, which is a major effect for anyone directly prosecuted.
dimensions.evidence: The bill expands prohibited conduct to include employing, using, persuading, inducing, enticing, or coercing a minor to be depicted engaging in sexually explicit conduct.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state any specific federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends existing federal criminal code definitions and statutes without creating new government agencies or broad programmatic frameworks.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2251(a) of title 18, United States Code, is amended by inserting after 'coerces any minor to engage in,' the following: 'or be depicted engaging in,'

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to federal criminal statutes with ongoing national reach.

missing_information: Specific estimates of the number of individuals affected or potential fiscal costs.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill expands existing federal criminal prohibitions related to child pornography and exploitation to cover minors depicted in sexually explicit conduct regardless of active participation. It affects individuals prosecuted under these statutes and federal law enforcement agencies.
